free_tier.stated: Unlimited asset storage on Hobby (free) with a 50 MB per-asset cap; 100 GB asset traffic/month

egress.terms: 100 GB asset traffic/month on Hobby, served from a global CDN (media.graphassets.com) with image transforms.

tooling: GraphQL Management API + REST asset upload endpoint, `@hygraph/management-sdk`, asset CDN URLs are public and transformable
chaining: Asset storage is declared UNLIMITED and the only per-unit cap is 50 MB/file — this is the 'per-record unlimited x unlimited records' shape the brief flags as qualifying. Bandwidth (100 GB/mo) becomes the binding meter. Projects per account not published; the Hobby plan is per-project.
limits_note: 50 MB per asset (Free/Hobby; 200 MB on Growth). 100 GB/month traffic. 2 locales, 3 seats, 10 components — content-model limits, not storage limits. 'Unlimited' is bounded in practice by the 100 GB traffic meter, not by bytes stored.
reliability_note: CDN-served, no expiry; the traffic cap is the failure mode (assets stop serving at 100 GB until reset).
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Hobby $0 always ... Unlimited asset storage | 50MB per asset upload size (maximum)'; 'Asset Traffic 100 GB'

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
